name: handover
description: Hand a session over to a fresh one before its context fills up: a separate model writes the handover from the transcript, /clear loads it

handover_dir.title: Handover folder
handover_dir.description: Base folder of the handover documents, written as YYYY/MM/DD/HHhMM-<topic>.md

suggest_tokens.title: Suggest a handover (tokens)
suggest_tokens.description: Context size at which the session is told, once, to hand over by itself (the handover skill) at the next boundary between scopes. Only below trigger_tokens. 0 never tells it

trigger_tokens.title: Trigger (tokens)
trigger_tokens.description: Context size at which the session is told to start no new task, finish those in progress (the current step, its subagents, its [await] commands) and hand over; the handover is written once it has. 0 turns the trigger off: handovers are then written only when the session asks for one (the handover skill) and before compaction

await_minutes.title: Wait for [await] commands (minutes)
await_minutes.description: During the wind-down, how long each background command tagged [await] (a test run, a build) is waited for before the plugin stops it and names it in the handover, as it does at once with [endless] ones

writer_model.title: Writer model
writer_model.description: Model that writes the handover from the transcript (claude --model value)

handover_chars.title: Handover length (characters)
handover_chars.description: Length the writer aims for. A loaded handover is cut at 9,500 characters, Claude Code's limit for injected context

warn_tokens.title: Status line warning (tokens before the trigger)
warn_tokens.description: How far below trigger_tokens the status line turns yellow

refresh_tokens.title: Refresh tolerance (tokens)
refresh_tokens.description: A handover this many tokens behind the session is rewritten before /clear, exit or compaction uses it

compact_reserve_tokens.title: Compaction reserve (tokens)
compact_reserve_tokens.description: How far below autoCompactWindow auto-compaction fires. /handover:stats uses it to estimate the margin until real compactions have been recorded

relay_limit.title: Relay limit (handovers)
relay_limit.description: Handovers in a chain of sessions the relay hands over to one another without the user. At the last one the chain halts, with a macOS notification and a terminal bell, and waits for /clear

delegate.title: Delegate to subagents
delegate.description: Tell each session, as it starts on a fresh context, to keep its own context for steering and give self-contained tasks to subagents, so it fills more slowly

yolo_guard_paths.title: YOLO guarded paths
yolo_guard_paths.description: Extra files or folders a YOLO run must not write, separated by spaces or commas (~ allowed), on top of the plugin, its data and the settings that load it: a gate the run must not edit to get through, for instance
